vocabulary.description: Most or all of the tree, shrub, vine, or herb is visible.
A main woody trunk is visibly prominent.
Bark texture or bark surface is visibly prominent.
A woody branch larger than a twig is visibly prominent.
A non-trunk stem is visibly prominent.
A current or small woody twig is visibly prominent.
One or more vegetative or reproductive buds are clearly visible.
One or more broad leaves or leaf blades are visible.
Needle-like or scale-like conifer leaves are visible.
One or more flowers or visibly flower-like reproductive units are present.
A flower cluster, catkin, or whole inflorescence is visible.
Fruit or a fruiting body is visible.
A seed or pollen cone is visible.
A seed is visibly isolated or is the main subject.
The camera looks upward along the trunk into the crown.
A leaf-off whole plant or crown is shown in winter condition.
Bark is shown on a large mature trunk.
Bark is shown on a medium trunk or large branch.
Bark is shown on a small trunk or branch.
A whole leaf is presented mainly from its upper surface.
The leaf edge or margin is the emphasized subject.
Leaves are shown in their visible arrangement along a twig.
Petiole attachment or orientation on a twig is emphasized.
Needle attachment to a twig or shoot is emphasized.
A leafless twig is shown in winter or dormant condition.
A leaf scar is clearly shown in close-up.
A terminal bud is clearly shown in close-up.
Fruit is visibly immature or developing.
Fruit is shown attached in its natural position on the plant.
Fruit is the close-up subject without a more specific condition.
Fruit is open, split, or sectioned so its interior is visible.
A flower or reproductive unit is shown at close range.
The interior of a flower is the emphasized subject.
A flower is viewed front-on.
A flower is viewed from the side.
A visibly male flower, inflorescence, or pollen cone is shown.
A visibly female flower, inflorescence, or seed cone is shown.
A closed or immature seed cone is shown.
A mature open seed cone is shown.
A receptive female cone is shown.

policy: Visible structures may co-occur. Specific view tags supplement, never replace, structure tags.
mapping_caveat: Mappings are for BioImages audit and vocabulary provenance; unlisted tags are not asserted absent and do not train the probes.
